text:
CAREER OPPORTUNITIES IN ICT
 Network Administrator
 Once installed on the right hardware platform and configured as a server, Network OS provide
 network management tools to network administrators.
 The Network administrator can use the tools to do the following:
 1. Secure the network against unauthorized access.
 2. Track network usage and keep a log of all the people who have used the network.
 3. Ensure that the various systems on the network are able to communicate and work with each
 other.
 4. Monitor the performance to ensure maximum throughput on the network.
